p: hearken thou unto the voice of: Because he has preferred you to this honour, you are bound to obey him.
slay both man and woman: That this might be an example of God's vengeance against those who deal cruelly with his people.
Kenites: Which were the posterity of Jethro, Moses father in law.
kindness to all the children of: For Jethro came to visit them, and gave them good counsel, Ex 18:19.
repenteth me that I have set: God in his eternal counsel never changes or repents, as in 1Sa 15:29, though he seems to us to repent when anything goes contrary to his temporal election.
commandment of the LORD: This is the nature of hypocrites to be impudent against the truth, to condemn others, and justify themselves.
little in thine own sight: Meaning, of base condition as in 1Sa 9:21.
He stands most impudently in his own defence both against God and his own conscience.
rebellion is as the sin of: God hates nothing more than the disobedience of his commandment, even though the intent seems good to man.
sin: This was not true repentance, but deceit out of fear for the loss of his kingdom.
neighbour of thine: That is, to David.
Strength of Israel will not lie: Meaning God, who maintains and prefers his own.
bitterness of death is past: He expected nothing less than death, or as some write, he passed not for death.
see Saul until the day of: Though Saul came where Samuel was, 1Sa 19:22.
repented that he had made Saul: As in 1Sa 15:11.
